Everyone was killed, including Master Halsey and his Padawan|[[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] reports on the aftermath of the battle|{{TCW|Witches of the Most}}}} The '''battle at the Temple of Eedit''' took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. ==The battle== {{Quote|Master!''"
"''Stay back!|[[Knox/Legends|Knox]] and [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] upon [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress's]] arrival|}} [[File:Halsey-Monster.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Knox and Halsey during the battle.]] Prior to the battle, Republic forces were in control of the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], which acted as a front for the Republic's military outpost. In order to gain control of temple, [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] sent his Separatist Army to attack. The Republic sent two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]—[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Halsey and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Knox—and several [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF troopers]]. The Republic troops were able to hold back the Separatist forces and held the upper hand in the battle. However, in order to test the powers of his new apprentice, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], Dooku sent him to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] to finish the battle and destroy the Republic forces. Opress mercilessly slaughtered all the clones upon his arrival, including ARF Commander [[Trauma/Legends|Trauma]]. This was made all the more easy by the clones foolishly attempting to engage Savage in close combat. Finding the two Jedi in front of temple's door, he attacked Halsey, and although the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] fought hard, Opress struck him down. Knox, after witnessing his master's death, attacked his master's killer. However, Opress effortlessly slashed him across the chest, sending him flying into the temple doors, dead. Upon successfully completing his mission, Opress returned to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|This is not the work of a Sith Lord, or a Jedi... but a reckless, impulsive animal.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:HalseyDeathHolo-WOTM.png|thumb|left|200px|A holorecording recovered of Halsey's death]] Soon after Opress's attack, [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] ([[RC-1140/Legends|Fixer]], [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] and [[Sev/Legends|Sev]]) arrived at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] with the dead bodies of Halsey and Knox, where [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] members [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] were all gathered to discuss the recent events on Devaron. Meanwhile, Savage Opress, upon his arrival at Serenno, told his master that the mission was a success. Dooku declared that the two of them would grow to be even stronger than [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and that they would rule the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Monster}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}} {{C|Appears in flashback and in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|122|Launchpad}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode314.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Witches of the Mist}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]] {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Scharmützel von Devaron |es=Batalla en el Templo de Eedit |it=Battaglia al Tempio di Eedit |pl=Bitwa o świątynię Eedit }} [[Category:Battles of Devaron]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]] [[Category:Genocides and massacres]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
